cards.text: Jesus, God's Son, and His disciples are almost to Jerusalem. They come to Bethphage, on the Mount of Olives, and Jesus sends out two disciples on an errand. I bet the rest of them are trying REAL hard to look like they didn't want to be picked.

cards.question: Jesus sends the two disciples into the village ahead. He says that at once they'll find a ___ tied there, with her colt beside her.

cards.text: Jesus tells them to untie both animals and bring them to Him. Friend, that's like walking up to a stranger's car in a parking lot, hopping in, and waving. "Don't mind me!"

cards.question: Jesus knows somebody might question the two disciples. True or false: Jesus says the owner will send the animals right away.
Jesus gives the two disciples one line for anyone who questions them: tell him that the ___ needs them.

cards.text: Then the story hits pause, like a storyteller leaning in close. All of this took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet.

cards.question: The prophet's message is for the Daughter of Zion. Who does he say is coming to her?
Zion's King is on the way. How does the prophet say He comes?

answers.text: Gentle and riding on a donkey
Armed and riding a war horse
Proud and riding in a chariot

cards.text: So the two disciples go and do just what Jesus told them. They bring back the donkey and the colt and lay their cloaks on them.

cards.question: The donkey and the colt are covered with the disciples' cloaks now. True or false: Jesus walks beside them instead of sitting on them.

cards.text: Then a crowd shows up, and it is MASSIVE. I'm talking circle-the-block-four-times-and-still-no-parking massive.

cards.question: That massive crowd gets busy as Jesus rides along. What do they spread on the road?

cards.text: Friend, that's a red carpet made out of everybody's jackets. Crowds are going ahead of Jesus and following behind Him, and every one of them is shouting.

cards.question: The crowds ahead of Jesus and behind Him are shouting Hosanna. Who do they shout Hosanna to?

cards.text: And they keep it coming: “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
Jesus enters Jerusalem, and the whole city is stirred. Picture an entire city looking up from its phone at the SAME time.

cards.question: The whole city of Jerusalem is stirred as Jesus enters. True or false: the city already knows exactly who He is.
The crowds answer the city: This is Jesus, the ___ from ___ in Galilee.

findings.problem: The question says 'the owner will send the animals right away.' Matthew 21:3 says 'If anyone questions you, tell him… and he will send them right away.' The text never calls him the owner. The card names someone the text leaves open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: The question says 'That massive crowd' spreads both the cloaks and the branches. Matthew 21:8 says the massive crowd spread their cloaks, 'while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.' The text doesn't say whether the 'others' belong to that crowd. The question and its right answer tie the two together.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: 'Every one of them is shouting' is told as a fact, outside the joke. Matthew 21:9 says only that the crowds ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting. 'Every one of them' stretches the text.

rule.text: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
